bronze_bush.description: Gleitbuchse aus Bronze / Bronze sliding bush

OD_30_k5.note: Bearing journal - datum features A and B

ID_20_H7.note: Finished bronze-bush bore - final after pressing

ID_24_H7.note: Bronze bush housing bore in steel

bush_OD_24_s6.note: Bronze bush OD - press fit into shaft

bush_interference.note: Min: 24.035 - 24.021 = 0.014 mm; Max: 24.048 - 24.000 = 0.048 mm. Controlled press fit required - do not hammer.

surface_finish.code_a: Ra 0.8 um - bearing journals O30 k5

heat_treatment.process_note: Exact method not stated on drawing - confirm induction, case hardening or nitriding with designer
heat_treatment.condition: Korrosionsschutzschicht und gehaertet / Corrosion protection and hardened
heat_treatment.note: CHD requirement is AFTER grinding - plan hardening depth accordingly to ensure minimum 0.5 mm remains after all stock removal

corrosion_protection.note: Coating type not specified on drawing. Clarify: black oxide / phosphate / QPQ / chemical treatment / plating
clarifications_needed: Masking of O30 k5 bearing journals
Masking of O24 H7 bush housing bore
Whether dimensions apply before or after coating

process_sequence.name: First CNC turning setup
sequence: Face first end
Centre-drill
Rough-turn concentric gripping and steady-rest band on OD
Rough external profile - leave 0.3-0.5 mm on diameter for grinding
Pilot-drill
U-drill or gun-drill main internal hole (L/D ~8:1 - use through-coolant insert drill or gun drill)
Rough-bore internal stepped portions
Leave internal finishing allowance
process_sequence.key_rule: U-drill BEFORE OD semi-finishing is completed - removing internal material after OD semi-finish causes distortion and concentricity loss

process_sequence.name: Second CNC turning setup
sequence: Reverse component
Face second end to establish machining length
Complete rough OD turning
Semi-finish all external diameters
Semi-finish internal stepped bores - O18 H6, O21, O24 H7 regions
Produce all shoulders, chamfers, radii and DIN 509 F0.6x0.3 undercuts
Leave external grinding allowance 0.3-0.5 mm on diameter

process_sequence.name: Stress relieving
process_sequence.note: Recommended after heavy drilling and roughing, especially if material straightness or residual stress is uncertain. Cool uniformly.

process_sequence.name: Keyway machining
process_sequence.machine: CNC VMC or keyway slotting machine
process_sequence.spec: 8 P9 width, 4+0.2 mm depth, 32+0.3 mm length
sequence: Fixture shaft from semi-finished journal axis
Rough and finish mill keyway
Deburr all keyway edges especially at ends
Verify orientation relative to datum features
process_sequence.key_rule: Keyway BEFORE pre-CG and BEFORE hardening. Asymmetric material removal from keyway can bend shaft and damage pre-ground surfaces.

process_sequence.name: Pre-heat-treatment QC
checks: All OD diameters and remaining grinding allowance
Keyway width, depth, length and position
Material certificate and heat number on file
Sufficient hardening depth planned to give CHD 0.5-1.5 mm after grinding
process_sequence.note: Dimensional errors are expensive to correct after component reaches 530-630 HV. This is a mandatory hold.

process_sequence.name: Optional pre-CG
process_sequence.condition: Only when required by approved hardening route
process_sequence.note: Do AFTER keyway, not before. Only needed when hardening supplier requires controlled pre-hardening diameter or uniform grinding stock.

process_sequence.name: Hardening
process_sequence.machine: Heat treatment furnace or induction hardening equipment
process_sequence.note: Use representative test coupon for case-depth validation

process_sequence.name: Post-hardening QC
checks: Runout at future O30 k5 journal locations
Crack test by magnetic particle inspection
process_sequence.note: Straighten before rough grinding if required

process_sequence.name: Rough cylindrical grinding
strategy: Grind both O30 k5 journal regions first - these establish datum A and B
Leave ~0.04-0.08 mm on diameter for final CG
process_sequence.note: Do not remove excessive stock - CHD requirement is 0.5-1.5 mm AFTER all grinding

process_sequence.name: QC after rough CG
checks: Runout of related diameters relative to A-B

process_sequence.name: Internal finish machining - steel bores
process_sequence.machine: ID grinding machine, CBN hard boring, precision honing, or fine boring (depending on bore hardness)
sequence: Finish O18 H6 to 18.000-18.011 mm - this becomes datum C
Finish O24 H7 bush housing to 24.000-24.021 mm
Finish O21 and central O19+0.2 as required
process_sequence.hard_bore_note: If internal bores are hardened (530-630 HV), use CBN hard boring, ID grinding or precision honing. Ordinary carbide boring will wear rapidly and give poor size control.
process_sequence.soft_bore_note: If bores are masked/remain soft, precision boring, reaming or fine boring is acceptable.

process_sequence.name: Internal bore QC
checks: O18 H6 size, roundness and taper
O24 H7 size, roundness and taper

process_sequence.name: Bronze bush manufacture and QC

spec.rough_ID_mm: ~19 mm or agreed undersize - leave sufficient stock for final O20 H7 after pressing
spec.lead_chamfer: Small chamfer for pressing - do not make large enough to reduce effective bearing length

qc_before_fitting: OD at 0 and 90 degrees for ovality
Measure actual O24 H7 steel bore and calculate actual interference
process_sequence.pairing_note: Pair measured bush OD with actual shaft bore - do not rely only on drawing limits

process_sequence.name: Post-press QC
checks: Bush face position and full seating
Steel OD distortion near press-fit region
Shaft runout before and after pressing

process_sequence.name: Final boring/honing of fitted bronze bush
process_sequence.machine: Precision boring machine, honing machine or ID grinder
process_sequence.critical_requirement: Must be coaxial to datum C within O0.015 mm
setup_methods: Line boring through fixture referenced from datum C (O18 H6)
Precision boring using mandrel/locator in datum C
process_sequence.warning: Gripping outside O35 or rough surface will NOT achieve O0.015 mm coaxiality to datum C. Must reference from O18 H6.

process_sequence.name: Bush bore QC
checks: Coaxiality to datum C - must be within O0.015 mm

process_sequence.name: Final cylindrical grinding
process_sequence.purpose: Light corrective grind to restore journals after bush pressing distortion
sequence: Finish O30 k5 to 30.002-30.011 mm
Finish O24 h7 to 23.979-24.000 mm
Finish all surfaces with 0.01 mm runout requirement relative to A-B
Achieve Ra 0.8 um on code-a surfaces
Maintain required hardened depth
conditions: Leave only small final CG allowance after rough CG
Do not locate through or load the bronze bush
Use protected centre holes or between-centres arrangement
Seal bronze bore against grinding swarf
Use adequate coolant - avoid grinding heat near pressed bush
Clean thoroughly afterward - abrasive in bronze damages mating shaft in service
Verify bush has not moved axially after grinding

process_sequence.name: Cleaning and corrosion protection
process_sequence.note: Confirm coating type, thickness and masking requirements before application. Do not coat O24 H7 bore unless coating thickness is included in machining calculation.

process_sequence.name: Final inspection
checks: Keyway parallelism 0.03 mm to datum A
Keyway symmetry 0.1 mm to datum A
Circular runout 0.01 mm relative to A-B on all specified surfaces
Circular runout 0.02 mm on left-hand feature
Coaxiality O0.015 mm relative to datum C
Surface roughness Ra 0.8 um on code-a surfaces
Cleanliness - no abrasive in bronze bush

machine_allocation.equipment: CNC lathe with through-coolant or gun-drill machine
CNC VMC or keyway slotting machine
Heat treatment furnace or induction hardening equipment
ID grinding machine or precision honing
ID grinding, fine boring or honing
Precision boring machine or honing machine referenced from datum C
CMM, air gauges, bore gauges, bench centres, roundness tester

drawing_clarifications.description: Drawing gives hardness and CHD but does not specify induction hardening, nitriding, carburizing or another method. Confirm before issuing heat-treatment purchase specification.
Coating type not identified. Coating thickness and masking could affect precision fits O30 k5, O24 H7 and O18 H6. Confirm process, thickness and masking.

drawing_clarifications.topic: O20 H7 final bore after bush pressing
drawing_clarifications.description: Drawing shows bronze bush with initial ID ~O19 and final ID O20 H7. Confirm that bush is intended to be finish-machined to O20 H7 after pressing - this is the logical interpretation but must be formally confirmed.

route_summary: Saw 42CrMo4 blank -> CNC turning setup 1: face, centre-drill, rough OD, U-drill, rough bore -> CNC turning setup 2: reverse, semi-finish OD and bores, shoulders, undercuts -> stress relieve -> keyway machining -> pre-HT QC (HOLD) -> optional pre-CG -> harden 530-630 HV -> post-HT QC (HOLD) -> rough CG on O30 k5 journals -> QC -> finish steel bores O18 H6 and O24 H7 by hard boring/ID grinding -> bore QC -> bronze bush manufacture and QC -> bush pressing -> post-press QC -> final bore O20 H7 referenced to datum C -> bush bore QC -> final CG light corrective grind -> clean and apply corrosion protection -> final inspection
